exercises.why: **производите** — производи́ть (imperfective): to make, to carry out, to execute, to effect; to give birth; to promote; to cause, to produce, to create. Wiktionary: про- + из- + води́ть.

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to lead, to conduct, to direct, to drive
to lead away; to take / draw aside; to take away
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: приводи́ть — to bring (someone with); повести́ — to lead, to conduct, to direct, to drive; отвести́ — to lead away; to take / draw aside; to take away; ввести́ — to introduce.
